status: BOOTSTRAP -- compact table shipped by mufflyaccess pending the versioned isochrones release (artifacts/workforce/urps_manifest.json). Swap to reading that release when it exists.
active_in_year_definition: A provider is active in year Y iff certification_year <= Y AND (retirement_year is empty OR retirement_year > Y). Retirement = isochrones 7-source consensus.
abog_abu_dedup_rule: ABU roster is NET-NEW to ABOG: ABU NPIs already present in the ABOG cohort are removed, so combined = ABOG + ABU with no double count.
geographic_scope: National (United States). ABOG by-year is the full NPI-matched cohort; no CONUS restriction applied to these counts.
known_limitations: ABU is a 2023 snapshot only -- no by-year ABU series (the ABU roster carries no cert/retirement year for a full panel), so 'abu' and 'abog_plus_abu' rows exist for 2023 only.
n_ever_certified / n_retired are unavailable for the abu and abog_plus_abu pathways (empty).
ABU source file is not yet a hashed isochrones artifact; the +308 comes from the cliff reconciliation (2026-07-24). source_sha256 is empty for ABU rows.
2013-2015 ABOG counts predate the ~2016 retirement-detection window and are approximate (they under-represent pre-2016 exits).
